name: The ship beneath the Deadmines

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The quest brings the search to VanCleef’s ship, hidden within the mine. Dark timber and rigging stand against the enclosing rock; the Brotherhood’s stronghold has become a vessel held far from open water. The composition follows the dungeon’s recognizable setting while leaving its exact scale, position, and deck arrangement to the game rather than the illustration.
